Li Chenming is an Architectural Designer and Researcher based in Hong Kong. He holds a Master of Architecture from The University of Hong Kong (HKU). His professional experience encompasses a diverse range of scales and typologies, from large-scale public institutions like the Wuxi Urban Construction Museum to educational facilities such as the Guangzhou Huawai International School. Prior to his current role, he contributed to the development of several international school projects in Shenzhen and Wuhan during his tenure at ZHUBO Design Group.

In addition to his design practice, Chenming is deeply engaged in computational research, specifically exploring the intersection of Artificial Intelligence and architectural production. While serving as a Research Assistant at HKU's Department of Architecture under Dr. Kaicong Wu, he focused on the strategic integration of text-to-image generation and evolutionary computing within multiplayer design processes. His research has been published in recognized international platforms, including ACADIA and Design Computation Input/Output. His work has received several accolades, including the Asian Design Award and the Anji International Bamboo Construction Competition award.
